title: 10 Smallmouth Bass Facts in Under 30 Seconds
hook: Ten smallmouth bass facts in under thirty seconds.
script: Ten smallmouth bass facts in under thirty seconds. Its bars run vertical, not sideways. Its upper jaw never reaches past the eye. Micropterus is Greek for small fin. Its name honors a French mineralogist. Anglers call it brownie or bronze bass. One male may spawn with several females. A nest can hold up to 10,000 eggs. Warm water can hatch eggs in two to three days. Dad guards the nest up to a month. World record: 11 pounds 15 ounces, from 1955. Which one did you already know?

claims.text: Smallmouth bass have dark vertical bands instead of a horizontal stripe.
A smallmouth's upper jaw never extends beyond the eye.
The species name dolomieu honors French mineralogist Dolomieu.
Smallmouth are also called brownie and bronze bass.
A male smallmouth may spawn with several females on one nest.
A smallmouth nest may hold as many as 10,000 eggs.
In mid-70s F water, smallmouth eggs can hatch in 2-3 days.
Male smallmouth guard the nest for up to a month.
The world-record smallmouth, 11 lb 15 oz, was caught at Dale Hollow in 1955.
